column3: Close to the Hebrew; “all of it gold” is rendered “of solid gold,” and “seven and seven pipes” “seven pipes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to level ground” is rendered “you shall become a plain!”, and “the top stone” “the capstone.”
Close to the Hebrew; “this house” is rendered “this temple.”
NKJV renders “the stone of tin” as “The plumb line,” and joins “these seven” to the rejoicing (“For these seven rejoice to see”).

Close to the Hebrew; “the clusters (branches) of the olive trees” is rendered “olive branches,” “beside the two gold pipes” “drip into the receptacles of the two gold pipes,” and “the gold” “the golden oil”; the meaning is uncertain.
NKJV renders “the two sons of the fresh oil” as “the two anointed ones.”
